requirement_binding.title: Comparative infrastructure-side RSU load-management investigation
requirement_binding.canonical_wording: TrafficTwin shall, if the late RSU research direction is confirmed, support comparison of the existing vehicle-side offloading arrangement with a deterministic/rule-based infrastructure-side load-management approach and a separately defined learned scheduling/load-management approach, identifying the operating conditions in which each approach performs better.
requirement_binding.status_note: S-035 / SANDRA-DIRECT-BODY-2026-08-04 raises direct source confidence for the RSU load-management problem and requested investigations A/B/C, but does not change the SHOULD priority or silently amend the frozen Negotiated Version 1. Directions A/B/C remain requested investigations / proposed directions / hypothesised outcomes, not mandatory assessed implementations without additional authoritative evidence.

lifecycle.conservation: offered = admitted + rejected; work conserved under substep-queue=sequential + rsu-cap-mode=reject

authority_boundary.vehicle_actor: Chooses only Local/V2I/V2V. Does NOT choose exact RSU. Frozen MAPPO 17D seed-100 lacks RSU load awareness (best_rsu_load_frac computed but omitted from observation).
authority_boundary.infrastructure_dispatcher: Selects execution RSU via strongest-link / JSQ / P2C / DLA / DLA-P2C downstream of actor mode; handles forwarding; controls scaling. DLA includes admission feasibility rule — not a pure placement effect.
authority_boundary.admission_gate: Per-RSU waiting-room ceiling; physical reject semantics; terminal rejection without queue entry.
authority_boundary.prohibited_claim: Do not credit MAPPO with exact RSU choice without exact checkpoint/observation evidence
